name: Reckoning - Attack at Atwater Village v1.4(in development)
author: rkimcsun
description: 2D Top-Down game to learn about fractions. Reckoning takes place in the village of Atwater. The village has had ten bridges destroyed by invading aliens and is currently cut off from the world. Players must collect pieces of boards (fractions) to rebuild the bridges and reconnect to the outside world. Invading aliens will try to stop the player by fragmenting collected whole boards. Once the player has delivered ten whole boards to a bridge, it is considered fixed, and the player may proceed. Addresses Whole Number Bias in learning fractions with the application of the concept of "putting fractions together" presented in publication: Putting Fractions Together. Braithwaite, D. W., & Siegler, R. S. (2020, March 19). Journal of Educational Psychology. https://doi.org/10.1037/edu0000477
